channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Em convenção do PT, Lula promete investir em defesa e proteger terras raras de China e EUA
item.description: Lula was officially confirmed as the PT’s candidate for re-election at a national convention. In his speech, he repeated his commitment to national sovereignty, he reaffirmed his commitment to national sovereignty, promising to invest in defense and protect the country’s rare earth minerals from foreign influence, particularly from China and the United States.

item.title: Bilenky: Lula tem discurso saudosista e expõe ônus e bônus de trajetória
item.description: Lula delivered a nostalgic speech at the PT convention that formalized his re-election bid, according to columnist Thaís Bilenky of UOL News. The tone reflected the weight of decades of activism and governance, highlighting both the burdens and benefits of his political trajectory.

item.title: Lula salva evento de vexame ao chamar Janja para discursar no palco
item.description: President Lula salvaged the launch of his candidacy from an embarrassing situation by publicly reprimanding the event organizers for the lack of female speakers and giving the floor to First Lady Janja. She spoke about the double burden faced by working women, including preparing lunchboxes, cleaning the house, and arriving home only at 10 p.m. Lula was praised for his gender sensitivity and for appealing to female voters.

item.title: Alckmin: “Urna eletrônica não aceita voto de argentino e de americano”
item.description: Vice President Geraldo Alckmin defended the security of Brazil’s electronic voting system, claiming it is so competent it does not accept votes from foreigners, such as Argentines and Americans. He linked criticism of the electoral system to signs of political defeat, referencing the participation of Javier Milei and Flávio Bolsonaro in events with foreign leaders as attempts at external interference. Alckmin also highlighted a 3.2% growth in Brazilian industry from 2023 to 2025, attributing it to the current government.

item.title: Lula critica emendas e fundo partidário: ‘Meu quarto mandato será para mudar’
item.description: Lula criticized parliamentary amendments and the party fund, calling them excessive and conducive to corruption, and said his fourth term would be to change the system. He also highlighted goals like fixing education and creating social spaces for the elderly. Lula was confirmed as a re-election candidate, leading in polls, while his main rival is Flávio Bolsonaro, imprisoned after a conviction for attempted coup.

item.title: Alckmin critica descrença nas urnas e celebra novo "Lula com chuchu"
item.description: Vice President Geraldo Alckmin (PSB) celebrated his partnership with President Lula (PT) during the PT's national convention that formalized Lula's re-election bid, referring to the duo as 'Lula with chuchu'. He emphasized their commitment to democracy, denounced disbelief in the electoral system as a sign of defeat, and praised the PT's militant base, stating their alliance aimed to save the country from the Bolsonaro government.

item.title: Michelle Bolsonaro diz que está internada em hospital e é dúvida na convenção do PL
item.description: Michelle Bolsonaro is hospitalized in Brasília due to a persistent headache lasting over ten days, casting doubt on her attendance at the PL party convention this Sunday, where her Senate candidacy was expected to be formalized. Deputy Bia Kicis confirmed Michelle could not attend her own Senate candidacy launch on Saturday and stated it remains uncertain whether she will be able to attend the convention. Meanwhile, Supreme Court Justice Alexandre de Moraes authorized Michelle’s sister, Geovanna Ferreira Lima, to visit jailed former president Jair Bolsonaro at his home to care for him and their young daughter Laura during Michelle’s temporary absence.

item.title: "Quem bate em mulher não vota em mim", diz Lula em convenção
item.description: Lula officially launched his re-election bid at the PT's national convention in São Paulo, declaring 'whoever beats women does not vote for me' and advocating for a society that respects women. He emphasized his political legacy as the driving force of his campaign and praised Geraldo Alckmin as his vice-presidential running mate, citing his competence as industry minister. The event also included criticism of Flávio Bolsonaro, whom Senator Simone Tebet labeled a 'golpist' like his father.

item.title: Lula é marujo confiável em momento de mar revolto, diz Haddad
item.description: Fernando Haddad described President Lula as a 'reliable sailor' to lead Brazil during a global 'stormy sea' marked by wars and the rise of the far right. He praised Lula’s ability to protect national sovereignty and announced the official launch of Lula’s re-election campaign at the PT National Convention in São Paulo. Haddad criticized the Bolsonaro government for dismantling the SUS, public finances, education, science, and technology, while refusing to call Bolsonaro 'president'.

item.title: Campanha de Lula lança pacotão de figurinhas para "zap"
item.description: President Lula's campaign launched a WhatsApp sticker pack featuring campaign-branded visuals, including Lula wearing a hat with the slogan 'Brazil belongs to Brazilians', the 'L' hand gesture, and the Brazilian flag, during the convention that formalized his re-election bid in São Paulo. The event emphasized national symbols as part of a strategy to link Lula's image with sovereignty and national identity.

item.title: Lula chama Janja para discursar: “Ninguém colocou mulher para falar”
item.description: President Lula (PT) criticized the absence of women speaking at the party's national convention, stating 'nobody put a woman to speak'. He then called First Lady Janja da Silva to speak, emphasizing the need for greater female representation.

item.title: Celina diz que empréstimo do BRB demora por causa da documentação de bancos
item.description: Federal District Governor Celina Leão stated that the R$6.6 billion loan to Banco de Brasília (BRB) is delayed due to documentation required by the banks participating in the guarantee consortium, with Banco do Brasil leading the process. The agreement was homologated by the STF on May 28, and BRB is in recovery phase, awaiting only final signature. Leão defended her management during her re-election campaign, accusing opponents of irresponsibility for failing to propose solutions to the bank's crisis, whose assets include public servants' pension funds.

item.title: Lula 'quebra protocolo' e convida Janja para discursar em convenção nacional do PT em São Paulo
item.description: During the PT's national convention in São Paulo, President Lula interrupted his speech to invite First Lady Janja to speak, criticizing the lack of female speakers at the event. Janja delivered a speech supporting Lula's re-election, emphasizing women's role in society and praising the government's social inclusion policies and efforts to combat violence against women.

item.title: Lula faz autocrítica por falta de discurso feminino em evento do PT e cede fala a Janja
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva made a self-criticism during a PT event confirming his 2026 re-election bid, noting the absence of female speakers. He yielded the floor to First Lady Janja, who emphasized women's crucial role in the electoral process and their decisive impact on Lula's re-election.

item.title: "Lula não baixa cabeça para presidente de outro país", provoca Haddad
item.description: Fernando Haddad, the PT's candidate for governor of São Paulo, stated that President Lula does not bow to leaders of other countries, in an indirect critique of Flávio Bolsonaro for his alignment with Donald Trump. Haddad emphasized that Lula defends national interests regardless of external pressures and praised his global experience, saying the world envies having a leader like him. The PT officially confirmed Lula's re-election bid for an unprecedented fourth presidential term.

item.title: Alckmin ‘esquecido’ na convenção do PT?
item.description: At the PT national convention on April 2, the presenter made a gaffe by skipping Vice President Geraldo Alckmin's (PSB) speech, going directly from Fernando Haddad's remarks to Lula's historical presentation. After being alerted, the presenter corrected the omission. The incident sparked speculation about Alckmin's role in the governing coalition.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro: o que entra e o que fica de fora nas privatizações
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro, the PL’s presidential candidate, is expected to revive the privatization agenda inspired by Paulo Guedes’ 2018–2022 management, but with less intensity and without large-scale operations like Petrobras. The focus will be on deficit-prone state-owned enterprises, with Correios as a primary target after posting an R$ 8.5 billion net loss in 2025. His economic team denies a formal list but confirms the policy direction, amid growing resistance from economic elites and concerns over his political radicalism mirroring his father’s.

item.title: Lula discursa em convenção que oficializa sua candidatura
item.description: Lula officially launched his re-election bid at a PT convention, stating his campaign is grounded in the achievements of the current government and does not require false promises. He said he plans to retire from politics after his term if elected, and delivered a strong message against gender-based violence, asserting that men who assault women should not vote for him. Lula also urged supporters to prioritize voting for state and federal candidates first, and only consider him if votes remain.

item.title: Haddad: “O mundo todo queria ter um Lula”
item.description: Former Finance Minister Fernando Haddad stated that the entire world would like to have Lula as president, emphasizing his leadership during a period of global instability. Speaking at the PT convention, Haddad described Lula as a 'reliable sailor' in a 'stormy sea,' highlighting his ability to steer the country through challenging times.

item.title: Convenção do PT divulga vídeo com 'tapete vermelho' para Lula e mostra até imagens com Trump
item.description: The PT’s national convention released a promotional video featuring a jingle that depicts President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva receiving a 'red carpet' welcome from global leaders, including Xi Jinping, Emmanuel Macron, and Donald Trump. The video was unveiled during the party’s event in the northern zone of São Paulo on Sunday, the 2nd, as part of its 2026 election campaign. The inclusion of Trump, despite ideological differences, drew attention for symbolizing international recognition of Lula’s leadership.

item.title: Novo protocola representação contra PT após Lula pedir votos em convenção
item.description: The Novo party filed a representation with the TSE against President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, Bahia Governor Jerônimo Rodrigues, former governors Jaques Wagner and Rui Costa, and the PT, alleging premature electoral propaganda during the PT's state convention in Salvador. The complaint claims Lula solicited votes at a party event, violating Brazil's electoral law prohibiting early campaigning.

item.title: Assim como Lula, Flávio Bolsonaro pediu votos antes do prazo legal
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ), a presidential candidate, asked for votes during a party convention in Santa Catarina, despite electoral campaigning legally beginning only on August 16. The move was likened to similar actions by Lula in past elections, who also sought support before the official campaign period.

item.title: Atlético-MG protesta contra arbitragem após empate com Juventude
item.description: Atlético-MG protested the refereeing after a 0-0 draw with Juventude in the first leg of the Copa do Brasil, claiming a clear penalty on Natanael was ignored by the referee and VAR. The club said it will seek clarification from the CBF and the Arbitration Commission and will take internal action against forward Reinier for insulting a fan after the match. Atlético-MG must win the return leg in Caxias do Sul to advance to the quarterfinals.

item.title: Governadora do DF, Celina Leão oficializa candidatura à reeleição
item.description: Governor of the Federal District, Celina Leão (PP), officially launched her re-election bid with the support of the União Progressista Federation, alongside vice-gubernatorial candidate Gustavo Rocha (Republicanos) and Senate candidate Bia Kicis (PL). She highlighted the recovery of DF’s finances, spending cuts, and health initiatives such as 20,000 private surgeries and 200,000 consultations, stating her ticket is 'clean' and not focused on eligibility. The event also featured Damares Alves and signaled expectations of PL joining the coalition, which currently includes PP, União Brasil, Republicanos, MDB, and Podemos.

item.title: Zema acusa Lula de cometer “ilícito eleitoral” por pedir votos
item.description: Presidential pre-candidate Romeu Zema (Novo) accused President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) of committing an 'electoral illicit' by soliciting votes before the official campaign start date of August 16. Zema shared clips from Lula's speech at the PT convention in Bahia, claiming the president violated electoral law by engaging in premature campaigning.

item.title: Empresário de Minas prepara proposta de governo de Flávio sobre terras raras
item.description: Flávio Roscoe, former president of Fiemg, is collaborating with presidenciável Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) on a government plan to facilitate the exploration and export of rare earth minerals, criticizing Lula’s opposition to exporting such resources. He claims Brazil holds the world’s best rare earth reserve in Poços de Caldas (MG) and argues the country should become a strategic exporter, likening its potential to Saudi Arabia’s oil reserves.

item.title: Golpista é sempre golpista, diz Tebet em referência ao clã Bolsonaro
item.description: Simone Tebet criticized the Bolsonaro clan, stating 'a coup plotter is always a coup plotter' and 'like father, like son,' during the PT National Convention that formalized Lula's re-election bid. She warned the 2026 election would be difficult, with the opposition spreading lies and fake news, and called on Paulista and Brazilian women to secure Lula's victory. The event, held at Expo Center Norte in São Paulo, also confirmed the Lula-Alckmin ticket and set the campaign launch for August 16 in São Bernardo do Campo.

item.title: As ‘vaquinhas magras’ dos petistas com histórico de corrupção
item.description: PT politicians with corruption convictions, such as Delúbio Soares, Agnelo Queiroz, and José Dirceu, are using TSE-authorized virtual fundraising campaigns ('vaquinhas') to finance their 2026 electoral bids, despite having access to public electoral funds and not returning misappropriated money. Delúbio Soares raised only R$700, Agnelo Queiroz R$500, and José Dirceu R$47,000 — amounts considered low given their lengthy prison sentences and available public financing. Their reliance on small-dollar online donations via platforms like QueroApoiar reflects an attempt to rebuild political image, but has so far attracted limited support.

item.title: “Libera o portão”, pede militância em Convenção Nacional do PT
item.description: PT militants without authorization pins gathered at the entrance of the National Convention, demanding the gate be opened. The organization eventually allowed everyone to enter. The event formally confirmed Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva's candidacy for re-election in 2026.

item.title: Veja fotos da convenção do PT que lançou Lula ao Planalto
item.description: The Workers' Party formalized the re-election candidacy of Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, aged 80, at a convention held at Expo Center Norte in São Paulo on Sunday, August 2, 2026. Lula is seeking an unprecedented fourth presidential term, with Geraldo Alckmin (PSB) again as his running mate. The event marked the eighth time Lula has run for President of Brazil.

item.title: Novo aciona TSE contra Lula por propaganda eleitoral antecipada
item.description: The Novo party filed a representation with the TSE accusing President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva of premature electoral campaigning during the PT’s state convention in Salvador, where he explicitly asked for votes before the official campaign start date of August 16. Novo requests an injunction to remove event videos from digital platforms and seeks the maximum legal fine against Lula and other PT figures. Lula’s remarks — including 'vote for me, I thank you' and 'elect me for a fourth time' — are cited as unlawful solicitation of votes outside the permitted period.

item.title: Podemos lança candidato ao Senado em SP, colado em Tarcísio, mas neutro na disputa presidencial
item.description: Podemos officially nominated businessman Geraldo Rufino for the Senate in São Paulo, with support from Governor Tarcísio de Freitas, while maintaining neutrality in the presidential race. The move aligns the party with the Centrão bloc and is seen as a strategic win for the Lula government in weakening Flávio Bolsonaro’s campaign. Rufino, founder of an automotive recycling company with R$50 million in annual revenue, emphasizes his rise from trash collector to entrepreneur as a key campaign narrative.

item.title: Lula é confirmado como candidato à reeleição e disputará Presidência pela sétima vez
item.description: Lula was confirmed as the PT's candidate for re-election at the party's national convention, running for his seventh presidential election and seeking a fourth term. The event emphasized women's rights, ending the 6×1 work scale, expanding microcredit, improving public health, and defending democracy, with backing from six parties and allied political leaders.

item.title: PT faz convenção ‘cênica’ neste domingo para exibir imagens de Lula nas redes
item.description: The PT held its national convention this Sunday in São Paulo, officially nominating Lula for re-election with Geraldo Alckmin as his running mate. Described as a 'cinematic' event, the convention featured short speeches and social media-focused content, including videos showing Lula with world leaders — such as Donald Trump — despite Lula’s rhetoric framing Trump as a foreign actor seeking to interfere in Brazil’s elections. The gathering launched the campaign’s ‘version 3.0 of us against them’ strategy, with the major inaugural event scheduled for two weeks from now in São Bernardo do Campo.

item.title: Lula é oficializado candidato à reeleição e tentará 4° mandato em novo embate com clã Bolsonaro
item.description: Lula, aged 80, was officially confirmed as the PT's re-election candidate during a convention in São Paulo, aiming for a fourth term. He seeks to renew his political confrontation with the Bolsonaro clan in a highly polarized election. The announcement was made on Sunday, February 2, 2026, at the Expo Center Norte.

item.title: Mercadante rebate Flávio, fala em omissão do governo Bolsonaro e diz que Lula investiu 80% mais em SP
item.description: BNDES president Aloizio Mercadante rebutted accusations from Senator Flávio Bolsonaro, stating that the Lula government invested nearly 80% more in São Paulo state than the previous administration, emphasizing increased federal funding for the state.

item.title: ‘Lula é o anti-Trump’, afirma presidente do PDT
item.description: The national president of the PDT, Carlos Lupi, stated that President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) represents the 'anti-Trump' in the world today, symbolizing the fight for democracy, peace, and the defense of the excluded. He declared that supporting Lula is choosing between civilization and barbarism, and that those not with Lula are with the right, the angry, and hatred, saying 'whoever does not believe the Earth is round' is on the opposing side. The statement was made during the PT’s national convention, which confirms Lula’s re-election candidacy for 2026.

item.title: PT confirma candidatura à reeleição de Lula em convenção em SP
item.description: The Workers' Party confirmed the re-election candidacy of President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva at its national convention in São Paulo. The event emphasized democracy and national sovereignty, leveraging the conviction of Jair Bolsonaro for attempted coup and Donald Trump's protectionist trade policies as campaign themes. Despite PT optimism due to Flávio Bolsonaro's failed alliances and weak messaging, both candidates face high rejection rates, with Lula leading at 40% voter intention versus Flávio's 32%, according to a recent Datafolha poll.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro é "golpista" como o pai, diz Tebet na convenção do PT
item.description: Former minister Simone Tebet (PSB) labeled Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) a 'golpista', comparing him to his father Jair Bolsonaro, during the PT convention that officially launched Lula’s 2026 reelection bid. She claimed the far-right seeks to erase hard-won rights and said Brazilians are beginning to recognize this. At 80, Lula is seeking an unprecedented fourth presidential term, with Geraldo Alckmin as his running mate, repeating the victorious 2022 ticket.

item.title: “Não tem ninguém aqui que foi pago pelo Lula”, diz Tebet
item.description: Former minister and PSB leader Simone Tebet stated during a PT live stream before Lula's convention that attendees at the Expocenter event were not paid by Lula, saying they were present out of gratitude. She praised the enthusiasm of supporters, referencing the potential for Lula to win a 'fourth star' in his political career. The remarks came amid allegations of paid support at government-aligned events.

item.title: Ambulantes vendem bandeira palestina e quepe de Che antes de ato do PT
item.description: Street vendors are selling political accessories such as Palestinian flags, Che Guevara berets, MST caps, and hats with the slogan 'O Brasil é dos brasileiros' outside the PT convention formalizing Lula's re-election bid. Items are priced between R$ 30 and R$ 40, with MST caps and nationalist slogan hats at R$ 30 each. The merchandise reflects left-wing symbolism and a lulist counter-response to Donald Trump's rhetoric.

item.title: Michelle Bolsonaro publica foto em cama de hospital
item.description: Michelle Bolsonaro, 44, was hospitalized on Saturday (Aug. 1, 2026) after undergoing medical tests and shared an Instagram photo of herself in a hospital bed, celebrating her first meal post-procedure. She thanked supporters for prayers and affection and confirmed she will run for a Senate seat from the Federal District, with Bia Kicis taking the other PL Senate slot. Michelle missed Kicis’s campaign launch due to her hospitalization but is expected to attend the PL convention in Brasília on Sunday (Aug. 2), marking her first public appearance with Senator Flávio Bolsonaro since their prior tensions.

item.title: PSTU lança Professor Robson como candidato ao GDF e Zanata ao Senado
item.description: The PSTU-DF officially nominated Professor Robson as its candidate for Governor of the Federal District, with Antônio Ricardo Martins Guillen as running mate, and Eduardo Rennó Zanata for the Federal Senate. The party will not field candidates for state or federal deputy in 2026, focusing instead on a socialist and anti-capitalist platform criticizing the Ibaneis-Celina administration and defending workers’ wealth production.

item.title: Lula migrou do Nordeste para São Paulo, liderou movimentos sindicais e pode chegar a 16 anos como presidente do Brasil
item.description: Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, the incumbent president and 2026 re-election candidate, is seeking a fourth term, which would bring his total time in office to 16 years, second only to Getúlio Vargas. Born in Pernambuco and raised in São Paulo from childhood, Lula built his career in the labor movement and is married to Janja da Silva, having faced multiple health challenges during his presidencies, including surgeries and cancer treatments. His ticket features Geraldo Alckmin as vice president, confirmed by the PSB.

item.title: Novo leva Lula ao TSE após discurso em convenção do PT na Bahia
item.description: The Novo party filed a legal action with the TSE against President Lula, Bahia Governor Jerônimo Rodrigues, former governors Jaques Wagner and Rui Costa, and the PT, alleging premature electoral campaigning during the PT’s Bahia state convention. The party claims Lula explicitly asked for votes in reference to the 2026 presidential election, which is prohibited before the official campaign period begins on August 16. Novo requests the removal of convention videos and the imposition of fines on those involved.

item.title: Campanha de Haddad aposta em temas nacionais e na privatização da Sabesp para levar eleição ao segundo turno
item.description: Fernando Haddad's campaign for São Paulo governor is focusing on the privatization of Sabesp, the Trump administration's tariffs, and national sovereignty to gain votes and push the election to a runoff. Campaign coordinators believe Tarcísio de Freitas has left gaps in his support, with dissatisfied mayors and legislators, and expect to gain momentum in the final stretch.

item.title: PT confirma Lula na disputa por um inédito 4º mandato
item.description: The Workers' Party confirmed Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva's candidacy for re-election to an unprecedented fourth presidential term in 2026, with Geraldo Alckmin as his running mate. The national convention was held in São Paulo, emphasizing the state's strategic importance for the PT campaign. Lula leads in first-round polling with 41% of voting intentions, followed by Flávio Bolsonaro at 35%, while the two are technically tied in a potential runoff scenario.

item.title: Deepfakes e imagens falsas: como a Justiça Eleitoral tem imposto limites ao uso de IA nas eleições
item.description: The Superior Electoral Court (TSE) approved Resolution 23.755/2026 to restrict the use of AI in the 2026 elections, banning deepfakes, manipulated content, and requiring transparency about AI-generated material. The resolution also imposes joint liability on AI platforms for failing to remove illegal content and sets limits on their operations, such as prohibiting candidate ranking and generating sexual images involving candidates. Experts are divided: some see progress in combating disinformation, while others warn of risks of summary censorship and lack of effective oversight of corporate compliance plans.

item.title: Lula oficializa candidatura à reeleição em convenção do PT em SP
item.description: The Workers' Party (PT) officially confirmed Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva's re-election bid at a national convention in São Paulo's Expo Center Norte, maintaining the 2022 ticket with Geraldo Alckmin (PSB) as vice-presidential candidate. The discreet, grassroots-focused event sets the stage for the official campaign launch on August 16 in São Bernardo do Campo, expected to draw 30,000 attendees. Lula seeks an unprecedented fourth term, backed by a coalition of left-wing parties, while Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) accused the federal government of sabotaging São Paulo's governor and declared the country 'can't take four more years of PT'.

item.title: Filho de Lula, Lulinha é
item.description: Former Minas Gerais governor Romeu Zema (Novo) has little chance of winning the presidency in 2026, but his campaign may leave a lasting legacy through the animated series 'The Untouchables', a high-quality political satire. The post title references 'Lula's son, Lulinha is...', alluding to Luís Cláudio Lula da Silva, though the excerpt provides no further detail about his involvement or a direct mention.
